name: prose-lint
description: Marks the sentences in Claude's writing that sound like a machine wrote them, and tells Claude to write them again in plain words. It checks chat replies, prose files, commit messages, and pull requests.

api_key.title: TypeSafe key for the judge
api_key.description: The key for Jev, the judge model from TypeSafe. It is kept in the system keychain. Without it, the plugin still checks banned phrases, em dashes, and long sentences.

message_format.title: Message form
message_format.description: short: one line for each finding, with a two-letter code. long: a full sentence of instruction with each finding.

write_feedback.title: Check prose files as Claude writes them
write_feedback.description: After Claude writes or edits a .md, .mdx, .txt, or .rst file, send it the findings for the new text.

commit_check.title: Commit messages and pull requests
commit_check.description: deny-once: stop a commit or a gh command once when its text has a finding. The same text a second time is passed.

reply_log.title: Record chat replies
reply_log.description: Record the findings of each chat reply in a log. Nothing is sent to the session.

session_report.title: Report at the start of a session
session_report.description: At the start of a session, give Claude four lines about its recent replies in the same project.
